# O.A.S.I.S.

> Local-first AI assistant for Windows 10 / 11 x64. Public beta v0.2.0.

## Product

O.A.S.I.S. runs compatible GGUF models locally and adds chat, voice, memory, documents, everyday PC tools and explicit permissions. The Personal edition is free and does not require an account. The application is proprietary; this public repository contains releases, documentation and transparency material, not application source code.

## Capabilities

- Local chat with streaming
- GGUF models via llama.cpp
- Voice in Spanish and English
- Memory and documents (basic)
- Everyday PC control
- 100+ tools across seven categories
- Up to three Personal projects
- 100+ registered product tools, with 10 high-impact tools requiring confirmation
- Max-only or planned: vision, advanced RAG, full coding agent, Docker sandbox, workflows, scheduled workflows, messaging, mobile/browser companions, MCP servers, voice cloning, encrypted sync, OpenCode integration, parallel sessions

## Network model

Local features run on your PC. Network-enabled features communicate externally only when you use or configure them. O.A.S.I.S. is offline-first, not network-blind. Web search, online pages, weather, translation fallbacks, messaging, companions and external MCP servers can require network access.

## Models

Compatible GGUF models are supported. Bundled profiles include `gemma-4b-it`, `qwen-2.5-1.5b` and `llama-3.2-3b`. Compatibility depends on model, quantization, context size, backend and hardware.

## Journal

Plain-language explanations, written for someone deciding whether a local assistant is real. Each one is a complete answer rather than a summary, and they exist in Spanish too.

- [What is AI? And how does it work?](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./blog/2026/09/25/what-is-ai-and-how-it-works/): What AI actually is, in two levels: the simple version (it predicts the next piece of text) and a deeper one (tokens, probabilities, context). (7 min read)
  - [Español](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./es/blog/2026/09/25/que-es-la-ia-y-como-funciona/)
- [What is a language model?](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./blog/2026/09/25/what-is-a-language-model/): Where a language model's ability comes from, what the billions of numbers inside it are, and the three questions that explain how it behaves. (7 min read)
  - [Español](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./es/blog/2026/09/25/que-es-un-modelo-de-lenguaje/)
- [Journal index](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./blog/)

## Glossary

77 terms defined in plain language, with a Spanish rendering for each. The same text appears as a tooltip on the pages that use it, so a definition is never longer than the page it sits on.

- [Glossary](https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./glossary/)
